description: Security controls are not periodically reviewed to ensure ongoing effectiveness. This signal indicates that control degradation or security drift may go undetected.
applicability: Applicable to all security control implementations. Includes scheduled reviews, control testing, and effectiveness verification on a regular basis.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through assessment schedule review, last assessment date verification, and control testing records analysis.

sources.title: 32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
